subsystem.name: VehiclePhysicsSubsystem
subsystem.responsibility: Vehicle physics and appearance runtime: per-frame tire-temperature stepping and visibility culling over the active vehicle array, wheel-contact transforms and tire-compound per-wheel setup, tire-brand data parsing, vehicle-file registry lookups and sorting, vehicle mesh/audio loading, particle collision emission, geometry recentering, and the vehicle debug overlay.

summary: DERIVED proposal for the vehicle_physics scope from 20 validated functions. The active-vehicle per-frame drivers (0x004B3BA0 IterateVehicles and 0x004B3DC0 VehicleVisibilityCulling) both iterate the live vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 gated by vehicle count dword_5C329C, so they are grouped as a GUESS class VehicleFrameScheduler; IterateVehicles advances per-vehicle tire temperature via 0x004C77D0 while VehicleVisibilityCulling runs camera-space culling through the session interface (dword_5EA510), the camera object (dword_7C54E0), EulerToRotationMatrix (0x00566E40) and a distance sort (0x005890AA) before driving audio/flag/UI transitions. The vehicle-file registry core is grouped as VehicleFileRegistry (GUESS) over the dword_8AC394/dword_8AC390/dword_8AC38C globals: VehicleLookupByName (0x004C3F80), CurrentVehicleAccessor (0x004C4080), VehicleDataLoader (0x004C4240, a string-key selection sort) and VehicleNameEnumerationThenNationalityLoad (0x004C7B20). Two distinct this-objects append vehicle indices to per-object linked lists with different field layouts, so they are kept separate: VehicleIndexListAccessor (0x004BFCD0, head at this+0x0, cursor this+0x8, count this+0xC, node data at *(this+0x8)) and VehicleSelectionListBuilder (0x004C4990, 0x004C4AA0, head/tail/first/count at this+0x8/+0xC/+0x10/+0x14). ResetVehicleDataStruct (0x004C3050) is the 1060-byte vehicle-file-entry initializer (VehicleFileEntry, GUESS). The vehicle physics body is split by ownership-uncertainty into separate GUESS classes: WheelContactUpdater (0x004EF180, rotation matrix 0x704..0x724, contact-normal array 0x3668), TireCompoundPhysicsApplier (0x004F18C0, per-wheel slots 13840..13880 + stride 248, fields 0x32BC/0x396C/0x3970/0x3BF4), TireBrandDefinition (0x004D6B00, front/rear tire blocks at +0x18/+0x160 with grip/wear/averaging), ParticleCollisionEmitter (0x004C9FB0, noise-table spread 0x18..0x38 + filtered record buffer), VehicleMeshLoadHandler (0x004A51C0, detail-level LOD mesh/audio load), VehicleTransformEmitter (0x004A27D0, guarded 6-parameter transform dispatch to 0x0054B4D0), VehicleScalarSampler (0x004B9E30, double-indirect read of vehicle+0xF8C), VehicleDebugOverlayRenderer (0x004DA0D0, two-column HUD text) and VehicleGeometryRecenteringHelper (0x004E2AD0, box-midpoint recenter of two scene objects). VehicleSetupDriverNumber (0x004C7B50) is the packet-labelled F1CVehicle (CONFIRMED) driver-number setup method and is kept as the single method of a GUESS F1CVehicle class because worker output cannot exceed GUESS. All class owners are GUESS except that packet labels the 0x004C7B50 owner CONFIRMED; function_roles carries evidence for every required function exactly once.

function_roles.role: Conditional transform/position forwarder: when the DWORD at this+0x64 is non-zero, dispatches this+0x4C/0x50/0x54 (DWORDs) and this+0x58/0x5C/0x60 (floats) to sub_54B4D0; otherwise returns this unchanged.

Tire/wheel graphics mesh loader: opens the tire-sound audio stream for handle a2, maps the global detail level dword_7CF884 through jump table jpt_4A5216 to an LOD scale (3.0/2.0/1.0/0.0), iterates file entries via ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag, resolves each name through the global instance table at dword_5CD620, hands entries to TireWheelGraphicsMeshLoader (0x004A4ED0), then conditionally cleans up the file handle; invoked by sub_4A4900.

Per-frame tire-temperature driver: iterates i from 0 while i < dword_5C329C (vehicle count), calls TireTemperatureSimStep (0x004C77D0) with dword_7C54F0[i], then returns the vehicle count; called from GamePostMainLoop (0x0042D8A0).

Per-frame vehicle visibility culling: resolves the session interface via VirtualDispatchHelper on dword_5EA510, skips the pass when the interface flag at +112 or the count bound dword_7CFC8C applies, else builds camera space from the camera object dword_7C54E0 and interface Euler angles via EulerToRotationMatrix (0x00566E40), sorts vehicles by planar distance with sub_5890AA, marks the nearest dword_7CFC8C visible, and on transitions starts/stops engine sound (0x004E0ED0), clears flags/UI (0x0054C030, 0x0054C1B0); called by RenderScreenSave (0x004B40A0).
Double-indirection vehicle scalar accessor: reads the vehicle pointer at this+0x0 and returns the DWORD at vehicle+0xF8C; sampled per frame by telemetry, render, particle and weather systems.

Indexed lookup into the global vehicle-file entry array: walks a singly-linked list from *this for a2 steps (next pointer at node+4), caches the current node in this+0x8, reads the vehicle-file index from *(this+0x8), and when below dword_8AC390 returns dword_8AC394 + 1060 * index (stride 0x424); returns 0 on any out-of-range path; called by GameFilterDataLoader (0x004C0DB0).

Vehicle-file entry initializer: zeroes alternating 0/-1 sentinel pairs this+0x00..0x24 and this+0x3CC..0x3DC, clears the dword block this+0x38..0x6C, sets this+0x70 to 1.0f, and clears scattered byte/dword flags (0x74, 0x7C, 0xBC..0x420); no reads, no calls; called by VehicleFileLoader (0x004C3D80) and VehicleDataLoader (0x004C4240).

Vehicle-file lookup by name: iterates entries at stride 1060 from dword_8AC394, compares each entry name pointer (defaulting to byte_5EA438 when null) against the search name via sub_588410 (0 return = match), and stores the matching index into dword_8AC38C; no write when the name, count dword_8AC390 or match is absent.
Bounds-checked index accessor: returns dword_8AC394 + 1060 * dword_8AC38C when the index is within [0, dword_8AC390), else 0.

Vehicle-file selection sort: initializes a temp buffer with 0x004C3050, and for each 1060-byte position at dword_8AC394 finds the best remaining entry via CompositeStringCompare (0x004C3890), then swaps it into place by copying string fields (realloc via 0x00566650 with 0x00415C30 null-safe dereference), dword blocks and byte blocks through VehicleDataCopy (0x004C45D0); runs only when dword_8AC390 > 0 and finishes with MultiFieldCleanup (0x004C3130).

Vehicle filtering by criteria list: when the first criteria word, the criteria count a3 and dword_8AC390 are all positive, iterates the vehicle array, skips slots already in the exclusion list (LinkedListKeySearch 0x004C4CB0) or null, requires every criteria value a2[v7] to compare equal at vehicle field byte offset 444 via sub_566810, and appends a 12-byte node (value pointer, next, flag byte at +8 = 1) with an allocated 4-byte index cell to the this-object list (head/tail/first/count at this+0x8/+0xC/+0x10/+0x14); returns the number appended.

Vehicle grid selection: scans the dword_8AC394 grid (dword_8AC390 slots, stride 1060), skips slots already registered (LinkedListKeySearch 0x004C4CB0) or null, matches the per-slot field at byte offset 444 against every value in a2[0..a3-1] via sub_566810, and appends an allocated 12-byte link (index-cell pointer, next, flag byte at +8 = 1) to the this-object list (head/tail/first/count at this+0x8/+0xC/+0x10/+0x14); returns the number of slots appended.

Two-step vehicle/driver delegation: calls VehicleNameEnumeration (0x004C3FE0) with the config path a2, then NationalityDriverInfoLoader (0x004C78F0) with this and the enumerated index dword_8AC38C, returning its result; used by NetCommPlayerSlotSync (0x0045FC50), LoadVehicleEntries (0x004B70B0) and ProcessDriverEntries (0x004B8DA0).

Vehicle setup step from VehgenScnFileLoader (0x004C6C40): looks up the driver number via NamedEntryLookupInFormatList (0x00415230) on the dword_5EA5E8 format list using a name at this+17952 and a list at this+18196, storing into this+0x489C; on a negative result falls back to a vehicle-array entry (dword_8AC394 + 1060 * field 0x4898) with byte_5EA438 default name; then scans the same format list with LinkedListIndexScannerWithValidation (0x00415550) on the long-description string at this+18104 and returns the stored index at this+0x48A0.

Particle collision spawn handler: with a collision source a2 and a live render list (0x0054C230), stores the source at this+0x0, computes the bounding box via 0x004DD550, re-centers this+0x4/+0x8/+0xC on the box midpoint, stores the half-extent at this+0x10, and when the vertical extent is positive seeds spread from the noise table flt_8AB274 with byte-wrapped index dword_8AAE70 into this+0x18..0x30, counts elements above the collision height into this+0x34, and fills a 20-byte-record buffer at this+0x38; called from SpecialFX_Init (0x004CF070).

Tire-brand definition parser: initializes grip/wear defaults (this+8/0xC = 1.0f, this+0x10 = 10, this+0x14 = 0), reads tokens via ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag (0x00566CC0) and sub_5651B0, selects the front (this+0x18) or rear (this+0x160) tire sub-block via sub_587C20, fills grip lat/long curves, radius/width/spring/damper/load-sensitivity/camber/rolling-resistance/heating/wear/AI tuning and optimum temperature/pressure fields through sub_565AA0 with the radius*RPM factor 9.549296585513721 and camber factor 0.0174532925199433, reads curve-name strings, averages the four dry-grip doubles into this+8 and four wet-grip doubles into this+0xC, computes and clamps the wear rating into this+0x10 via CRTFtol (0x00587BDC); invoked by TireBrandFileParser (0x004D7150).

Two-column vehicle debug/HUD overlay: a byte flag at this+0x18 selects which of this+0x1C and the camera global dword_7C54E0 supplies the left entity, and for each non-null entity renders a gear/position '%c' character (*(entity+0x4060)-1 plus byte_5D4AE8), the name string at *(entity+0x46F8) normalized via sub_589901, indexed single-character entries from dword_5D4AF4 with base bytes byte_5D4AF0/byte_5D4AF1, and the speed of this+0x14 as '%6.3f'; all drawn via UITextRenderWithScale (0x004D7E40) with the format helper 0x0058815F; called by sub_4D9F80.

Physics/audio geometry recentering: computes the primary object's bounding box via 0x004DD550, derives its midpoint, and for each of two scene objects offsets the object position (via 0x0054B420/0x0054B3B0) and every packed vertex (0x0054E100/0x0054E120) by the midpoint, clears per-child flags, and rebuilds each child's bounding box (0x0054D520/0x0054E270/0x0054D080); called from the vehicle graphics scene loader.

Wheel-contact transform: for each of four wheel-corner vectors (advancing 74 floats / 62 pointer slots per step to 296 floats), rotates the per-corner offset (this[523..525]) by the 3x3 rotation matrix at this+0x704..0x724, adds the world-origin offset this[443] via F_3DVectorAddition (0x004EC020), queries the collision normal from feature data dbl_7C9360 via CollisionNormalFromFeature (0x0044C550), stores it into the contact-normal pointer array at this+0x3668 with a 0.050000001 depth adjustment, and updates wheel-surface friction via WheelSurfaceContactFriction (0x004CE110); runs once per frame tick.

Tire-compound setup for one wheel index: stores the compound index a3 at this+0x3970, resolves the compound entry via CompoundIndexLookup (0x004D7570) from the table at this+0x396C, maps the name (byte_5EA438 fallback) through TireCompoundNameIDMapping (0x004A4830) and MultiplayerSessionType (0x004E2370), selects front (entry+6) or rear (entry+88) data, computes per-wheel force/spring/load/grip values at this+13840..13880 (plus 248 * a2) using VehicleSuspensionForceHelper (0x004D6AE0), the load scale at this+0x3BF4 and DivisionWithThreshold (0x004D5EA0), optionally runs TireBrushModelForceSolver (0x004E8010), and when no rigid body is attached (this+0x32BC == 0) records the index in dword_7C8884 and applies via TireCompoundPerWheelPhysicsApplication (0x0043DA10) on dbl_7C7428.

classes.name: F1CVehicle
classes.responsibility: The packet labels VehicleSetupDriverNumber as a F1CVehicle (CONFIRMED) method; this class keeps the single evidenced driver-number setup step and the three vehicle identity fields it reads/writes. Worker trust is capped at GUESS.

classes.name: VehicleFileRegistry
classes.responsibility: Free-function group over the global vehicle-file entry array (dword_8AC394, 1060-byte stride, count dword_8AC390, current index dword_8AC38C): name lookup, bounds-checked index access, string-key selection sort and the enumerate-then-load-nationality delegation.

classes.name: VehicleIndexListAccessor
classes.responsibility: This-object owning a singly-linked list of vehicle-file indices (head at this+0x0, iteration cursor this+0x8, count this+0xC; node data pointer at *(this+0x8)); resolves a2-th entry to a dword_8AC394 element or 0.

classes.name: VehicleSelectionListBuilder
classes.responsibility: This-object owning a linked list of selected vehicle indices (head this+0x8, tail this+0xC, first this+0x10, count this+0x14) that both filter and grid-selection functions append to; nodes are 12-byte allocations with a value pointer, next pointer and flag byte at +8.

classes.name: VehicleFileEntry
classes.responsibility: The 1060-byte vehicle-file entry initializer: sentinel pair groups, cleared dword/byte flags, a 1.0f field at +0x70; used as both the real entry init and the temp-buffer init for the registry sort.

classes.name: VehicleFrameScheduler
classes.responsibility: Per-frame active-vehicle pass drivers sharing the dword_7C54F0 vehicle pointer array and dword_5C329C count: tire-temperature stepping and camera-space visibility culling with audio/flag/UI transitions.

classes.name: VehicleTransformEmitter
classes.responsibility: Object that conditionally forwards six transform/position parameters to the shared scene transform setter sub_54B4D0 when the guard at this+0x64 is active.

classes.name: VehicleMeshLoadHandler
classes.responsibility: Vehicle tire/wheel graphics mesh loading: audio-stream open for the tire sound handle, detail-level LOD scale selection from dword_7CF884, file-entry iteration, name resolution against the global instance table and per-entry mesh loader handoff.

classes.name: VehicleScalarSampler
classes.responsibility: Double-indirection sampler returning the DWORD vehicle scalar at vehicle+0xF8C through the vehicle pointer stored at this+0x0; consumed by telemetry, render, particle and weather per-frame paths.

classes.name: ParticleCollisionEmitter
classes.responsibility: Collision-driven particle spawn: stores the collision source, computes a bounding-box midpoint and half-extent, seeds spread direction/magnitude from the flt_8AB274 noise table (byte-wrapped dword_8AAE70 index), counts elements above the collision height and fills a 20-byte-record filtered buffer at this+0x38.

classes.name: TireBrandDefinition
classes.responsibility: One tire-brand definition: front tire block at this+0x18 and rear block at this+0x160 with grip lat/long curves, geometry, suspension, camber, thermal/wear and AI-tuning doubles, plus averaged grip multipliers at this+8/this+0xC and a clamped wear rating at this+0x10.

classes.name: VehicleDebugOverlayRenderer
classes.responsibility: Two-column HUD/debug text overlay for two entities: gear/position character, normalized name, indexed single-character entries and a '%6.3f' speed readout rendered with UITextRenderWithScale.

classes.name: VehicleGeometryRecenteringHelper
classes.responsibility: Recenters two scene objects and all their packed vertices onto a computed bounding-box midpoint, clears per-child flags and rebuilds child bounding boxes.

classes.name: WheelContactUpdater
classes.responsibility: Transforms the four wheel-contact corner vectors by a 3x3 rotation matrix, adds the world origin, queries and stores collision normals per corner and updates wheel-surface friction.

classes.name: TireCompoundPhysicsApplier
classes.responsibility: Per-wheel tire-compound setup: resolves the compound by index/name, selects front or rear compound data, computes per-wheel force/spring/load/grip values in the 248-byte wheel slot at this+13840..13880, optionally runs the brush-model solver, and applies the compound through the physics application when no rigid body is attached.

state_machines.name: VehicleVisibilityTransition
transitions: from any state: skip the culling pass when the session interface flag at +112 is set or the vehicle count dword_5C329C does not exceed the visible-index bound dword_7CFC8C

to culling_required when the camera object dword_7C54E0 is non-null: transform each vehicle position to camera space, sort by planar distance, mark the nearest dword_7CFC8C vehicles visible in the byte work buffer
on a new-visible transition: start the vehicle engine sound via AudioSoundEffectController (0x004E0ED0) using the vehicle +4180 field
on a new-hidden transition: clear flags (0x0054C030 twice) and update UI state (0x0054C1B0)

state_machines.name: TireBrandTokenParse
transitions: iterate while ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag (0x00566CC0) reports input and sub_5651B0 does not return a terminal status (1 or 4)
on the aFront_0 token: switch the active block pointer v3 to this+0x18 (front block)
on the aRear_0 token: switch the active block pointer v3 to this+0x160 (rear block)
per token: parse curve doubles through sub_565AA0, strings through sub_5654A0/StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, and the wet-weather flag into this+0x14
after the loop: average dry/wet grip doubles into this+8/this+0xC and clamp the wear rating into this+0x10

state_machines.name: TireCompoundPerWheelSetup
transitions: to resolving_compound: store a3 at this+0x3970 and resolve the entry via CompoundIndexLookup (0x004D7570) from this+0x396C
name mapping: TireCompoundNameIDMapping (0x004A4830) + MultiplayerSessionType (0x004E2370) record the compound id at this+1764
to selecting_data: choose entry+6 doubles for wheel index <= 1 else entry+88 doubles
to computing_wheel_values: fill this+13840..13880 (plus 248*a2) using VehicleSuspensionForceHelper (0x004D6AE0), the this+0x3BF4 load scale and DivisionWithThreshold (0x004D5EA0)
to applying when this+0x32BC == 0: write dword_7C8884 and call TireCompoundPerWheelPhysicsApplication (0x0043DA10) on dbl_7C7428

interfaces.name: FileStreamTokenParser
interfaces.purpose: File/config token-stream parsing helpers shared by mesh loading and tire-brand parsing: buffer init/cleanup, dispatch-flag iteration, token status read, string/name/flag token reads, curve parse, string realloc-copy, audio open/close and block selector.

interfaces.name: VehicleRegistryService
interfaces.purpose: Vehicle-file entry lifecycle and comparison helpers: entry init/cleanup, composite-string compare, name enumeration, entry copy, keyed-list search, nationality/driver load, name compare, field compare and 4/12-byte allocation.

interfaces.name: SceneGraphGeometryService
interfaces.purpose: Scene-graph and packed-vertex geometry helpers: position triple get/set, transform dispatch, child-count/index accessors, packed-array total/index, bounding-box compute and rebuild, and post-process hooks.

interfaces.name: CollisionQueryService
interfaces.purpose: Collision and math helpers: bounding-box computation, collision-normal lookup from feature data, vector addition, Euler-to-rotation-matrix conversion and float-array sorting.

interfaces.name: TirePhysicsService
interfaces.purpose: Tire physics helpers: per-vehicle temperature simulation step, suspension force evaluation, threshold division, compound index lookup and name-to-id mapping, session-type record, brush-model force solver, compound application and surface friction update.

interfaces.name: TextRenderService
interfaces.purpose: Text formatting and overlay rendering: string formatting with buffer overflow check, name-string normalization and text rendering with scale.

interfaces.name: FormatListLookupService
interfaces.purpose: Named-entry format-list lookups: name-keyed entry lookup in a format list and linked-list index scanning with validation, used by the vehicle setup path.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleFileRegistryContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable must keep the global vehicle-file entry array dword_8AC394 (1060-byte stride, element fields read up to 0x424) with entry count dword_8AC390, current-index global dword_8AC38C, adjacent dword_8AC388, and the default-name string byte_5EA438; per-slot selection compares the field at byte offset 444.

compatibility_contracts.name: ActiveVehicleGridContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The per-frame vehicle passes depend on the live vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 with count dword_5C329C, the camera/track object dword_7C54E0 (camera position at +13536/+13540/+13544), the session interface dword_5EA510 (flag at +112, Euler angles at +24) and the visible-vehicle bound dword_7CFC8C.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireBrandDefinitionContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Tire-brand objects must carry a front tire block at this+0x18 and a rear tire block at this+0x160 with grip-curve doubles, a wet flag at this+0x14, averaged dry/wet grip multipliers at this+8/this+0xC and a wear rating clamped to [7,15] at this+0x10; the parser applies radius*RPM factor 9.549296585513721 and camber degrees-to-radians factor 0.0174532925199433.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireCompoundWheelContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-wheel compound setup writes a 248-byte wheel slot at this+13840..13880, gated by the rigid-body guard this+0x32BC, reading the compound table at this+0x396C, the index at this+0x3970 and the load scale at this+0x3BF4; when no rigid body is attached it records the index in dword_7C8884 and applies via TireCompoundPerWheelPhysicsApplication on dbl_7C7428.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelContactContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The wheel-contact transform reads a 3x3 rotation matrix at this+0x704..0x724, a world-origin offset at this[443], feature data at dbl_7C9360 and writes the four-corner contact-normal pointer array at this+0x3668, updating wheel-surface friction per contact.

compatibility_contracts.name: DetailLevelLodContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The tire/wheel mesh loader maps the global detail level dword_7CF884 (values 0..3) through jump table jpt_4A5216 (0x004A5314) to LOD scale factors 3.0/2.0/1.0/0.0, resolving entry names against the global instance table at dword_5CD620.

compatibility_contracts.name: ParticleNoiseTableContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Particle collision emission samples the flt_8AB274 noise table using the byte-wrapped post-increment index dword_8AAE70 to seed scale/lifetime/angular-rate/direction fields, and fills a 20-byte-per-record filtered buffer at this+0x38.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleDebugOverlayContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The vehicle debug overlay reads entity gear/position at *(entity+0x4060) and the entity name pointer at *(entity+0x46F8), renders '%c' (global aC at 0x005CCEF0) and '%6.3f' (global a63f at 0x005D4B40) literals in the default color flt_5ACF60, and appends indexed single-character entries from dword_5D4AF4 with base bytes byte_5D4AF0/byte_5D4AF1.

unresolved: Class owners are all GUESS: every packet owner is UNKNOWN except VehicleSetupDriverNumber (0x004C7B50), which the packet labels F1CVehicle CONFIRMED; worker output is capped at GUESS, so F1CVehicle remains a GUESS class here.

Equal offsets on distinct this pointers are not treated as identical fields: WheelContactUpdater (this+0x704..0x724), TireCompoundPhysicsApplier (this+0x32BC/0x396C/0x3970/0x3BF4) and F1CVehicle (this+0x4898..0x48A0) are kept as separate classes because the packet does not prove common ownership.

The flt_59E4xx / flt_59E6xx / flt_59E7xx / flt_59E8xx / dbl_59E9xx / dbl_59EAxx / dbl_59EBxx / dbl_59ECxx / dbl_59EDxx / flt_5ACExx / dbl_5ADxxx globals listed by packet facts never appear as named operands in the raw decompiled bodies; they are carried in unresolved_evidence_refs, not located.
sub_54B4D0's six parameters (3D position/transform semantics) and the this+0x64 guard type are DERIVED from existing analysis, not evidenced by this packet (0x004A27D0).

TireWheelMeshLoadLoop argument roles a2/a3 and the v5 entry-handle value are unaccounted; locals v10..v14 are initialized but unused; sub_5651B0's zero-return gate may be negative logic; dword_7CF884 detail-level semantics (pitcrew vs car meshes) are not in the packet.
dword_5C329C has no recorded writers in the packet; dword_7C54F0 length is unbounded; TireTemperatureSimStep's thermal model is not described (0x004B3BA0).

VehicleVisibilityCulling's v30 byte-buffer layout (new/previous flags, distance slots) and the unnamed camera offsets +13536/+13540/+13544 and vehicle offsets +3384/+3388/+3392 are inferred from index arithmetic; flt_59E440/flt_59E660/flt_59E8C8 are absent from the raw source.
The vehicle scalar at vehicle+0xF8C has no documented meaning; the owner type behind this+0x0 is unlabeled (0x004B9E30).

VehicleArrayIndexAccessor's linked-list node layout is implied only by the raw walk; the 0x424 stride semantics of dword_8AC394 are DERIVED; a null node data pointer is dereferenced without a v6 guard (0x004BFCD0).

ResetVehicleDataStruct's alternating 0/-1 sentinel pairs suggest {value,id} slots or a list-head pattern whose precise role is unresolved; the 'State_Struct_Multi_Field_Init' packet abi label is generic (0x004C3050).
VehicleLookupByName's sub_588410 comparison semantics (case, partial/full), the 1060-byte entry layout beyond the name pointer, and the byte_5EA438 default-string role are unresolved (0x004C3F80).
CurrentVehicleAccessor's 1060-byte element type is unconfirmed and distinct from the known 0x48C0 vehicle-struct stride (0x004C4080).

VehicleDataLoader's selection-sort reading is grounded in the compare + conditional-swap pattern, but the composite key semantics and VehicleDataCopy's source/destination direction are not verified from this packet alone (0x004C4240).

The node flag byte at +8 (initialized to 1), the sub_566810 comparison contract, the first-vs-head relationship at this+0x10/this+0x8, and the caller sub_4C4D50 (0x004C4D50) are unresolved for both VehicleFilteringSelection and VehicleGridSelection.
VehicleNameEnumerationThenNationalityLoad reads dword_8AC38C without seeing its producer, and unk_8AC388 is flagged but absent from the raw source (0x004C7B20).
The identity of the strings at this+17952/+18196/+18104 and the meaning of the 0x48A0 long-description index are unresolved (0x004C7B50).

ParticleCollisionEmitter's noise-table length and byte-wrapped aliasing, the bounding-box axis correspondence, and the missing cos/sin/sqrt callees are unresolved; ten read-only flt/dbl globals are absent from the raw body.

ParseTireBrandData token statuses 1 and 4 from sub_5651B0 and the front/rear block layout (DERIVED from raw offsets) are not independently evidenced; six double-constant globals are absent from the raw source.

renderVehicleDebugOverlay: the this+0x18 flag's two data sources are not proven the same type, sub_589901's normalize transform is unknown, the byte_5D4AF0/byte_5D4AF1 bases and byte_5EA438 prefix are not evidenced in meaning, and the '%c'/'%6.3f'/color global ties are DERIVED.
VehicleGeometryRecenteringHelper: the per-child flag bits, sub_54D080 semantics and whether the two objects are distinct or aliased are unresolved; global 0x0059E450 is absent from the raw body.

WheelContactTransform: the dbl_7C9360 structure is unnamed, the four constant dwords (v12..v15) in the query payload are unexplained, the 0x704..0x724 frame naming is unverified, and global 0x0059E448 is absent from the raw body.

TireCompoundSetupWheel: the 248-byte per-wheel slot layout and compound data element meanings (indices 0..34) are inferred only from consuming formulas; five read-only globals are absent from the raw body.
